newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thoresen to buy four cargo vessels.
newsitem.headline: Thoresen to buy four cargo vessels.

text.p: Thoresen Thai Agencies Plc said on Monday it would buy four cargo vessels worth a total of $17 million.
Thoresen Thai said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that a decision to buy the four vessels was made during the shipping company's board meeting on Friday.
Delivery of the vessels, built around 1986, would be made by September 30 and the company was holding negotiations with financial institutions to fund the buying, it said.
The company has also decided to invest in four new subsidiary shipping companies, Thor Sun Shipping Co Ltd, Thor Sea Shipping Co Ltd, Thor Sky Shipping Co Ltd and Thor Spirit Shipping Co Ltd.
Investment in each of the companies was 500,000 baht, or 99.99 percent of total equity, it said. ($1 = 25.9 baht) -- Bangkok newsroom (662) 652-0642
